objective: Extract the liquid topology, bridge breakage, inertia/snap, pointer hysteresis/wake, and text morph mechanisms for a short portfolio work experience.

targetLock.rendering: single fullscreen fragment shader over CPU supplied rest geometry
targetLock.interaction: wheel and drag angular inertia with late slot snap; fast acquire and slow release hover
targetLock.motion: birth, spread, stage, steady interaction; ICE particle additions are optional and bounded

hypotheses.claim: The liquid silhouette is a polynomial smooth-min union of rounded-box SDFs plus explicit swept-box bridges.
Life-like hover comes primarily from asymmetric acquire/release and a velocity-driven radial wake, not from particles.
ICE retains the Viscose material and adds a bounded ASCII particle layer.
